adapter_config.description: Copied verbatim from [executor.<adapter>]; shape is the adapter's own contract, not this schema's.

executor_identity.description: Set by the product, never the tenant's git config (issue #33); every commit between start_sha and sha must carry it.

reports.description: Field names adapters/<name>/conformance.json declares this adapter can supply with a real value (vendor independence, 2026-09-09 ruling) -- [] when the adapter declares no conformance.json. Dollars are never summed across adapters; a field absent here renders as not reported by this executor, never zero or blank.

checks.description: Null when the manifest declares no [checks] table.

cost_usd.description: The tool's list-price meter, from the adapter's own report. Billed only when the build ran under adapter_config.auth = "api"; under auth = "subscription" this figure is a measure, not a bill -- usage is included in the operator's plan.

stop.description: Non-null exactly when status is not "pass" (issue #89): what class of stop this is and whose it is, derived by the record writer from the refusal, halted, and log it already has -- never a fresh read of anything.

signature.description: R3: the failure's signature, the detail or last event with every run of digits removed; equal between two attempts means the same failure

bound.description: R3: the bound a hung invocation crossed, or null

detail.description: Populated for class "unclassed" (the log's last line, capped at 200 characters), class "question" (the halt's own question, its first line only), class "environment" ([checks].command's last output line, capped at 200 characters), and class "gate" (a refused spec-gate record's own refusal string, issue #137 -- never persisted on an actual build record; read here only because stop_class_enum sources the enum from this schema); null for every other class, whose evidence already lives in refusal, halted, or the log itself.

retry_of.description: R3: the stem of the attempt this one retries, or null on a first attempt

steer.description: R3: the counsel or ruling record whose text this attempt was handed, or null
